_LEEME: Catálogo del estimador. 'actuales' = lo que el cliente puede tener hoy en el techo (paso 'What is currently on your roof?'). 'materiales' = materiales que una compañía puede ofrecer, con su foto y descripción por defecto. En compania/sitio.json cada compañía elige los suyos y pone SUS precios. Las fotos de img/ son de referencia del material (no son trabajos de nadie): la compañía puede cambiarlas por fotos propias.

3tab.desc: A traditional, budget-friendly asphalt shingle with a flat, uniform look.

arch.desc: Dimensional asphalt shingles with a high-end look, strong wind ratings and a long manufacturer warranty.

designer.desc: Premium asphalt shingles that mimic slate or wood shake, with extra thickness and curb appeal.

rpanel.desc: A durable, cost-effective exposed-fastener metal roof for homes, shops and commercial buildings.

standing-seam.desc: A premium metal roof with hidden fasteners and a clean, modern look. Built to last decades.

clay-tile.desc: A long-lasting natural clay roof with a timeless, high-end look.

slate.desc: Natural stone roofing prized for its elegance and exceptional lifespan.

tpo.desc: A single-ply membrane for flat and low-slope roofs. Energy efficient and resistant to UV and heat.

pvc.desc: A durable single-ply membrane with welded seams and strong chemical resistance.

modified-bitumen.desc: A tough multi-layer asphalt-based system for flat and low-slope roofs.
